thread.title: Daily Dividend Report: JNPR, AAPL, MRK, MCD, LUV

title: Daily Dividend Report: JNPR, AAPL, MRK, MCD, LUV
text:
Daily Dividend Report: JNPR, AAPL, MRK, MCD, LUV Wednesday, January 30, 2:18 PM ET 10 mREITs With Impressive Yields » Juniper declared an increase of its quarterly cash dividend to $0.19 per share to be paid on March 22, 2019 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 1, 2019. This reflects an increase of approximately 6% compared to previous quarterly dividends.
Apple has declared a cash dividend of $0.73 per share of the Company's common stock. The dividend is payable on February 14, 2019 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on February 11, 2019.
Merck (NYSE: MRK ) has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.55 per share of the company's common stock for the second quarter of 2019. Payment will be made on April 5, 2019 to shareholders of record at the close of business on March 15, 2019.
McDonald's declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.16 per share of common stock payable on March 15, 2019 to shareholders of record at the close of business on March 1, 2019.
Southwest Airlines (NYSE: LUV ) declared a quarterly dividend of $.16 per share to Shareholders of record at the close of business on March 6, 2019 on all shares then issued and outstanding. The 170th consecutive dividend will be paid on March 27, 2019.
For MarketNewsVideo.com, I'm Sayoko Murase.
